Title: Pollen limitation in _Primula veris_ along an elevation gradient
Authors: Jana Nováková (1,2)*; John Smith (2); Ana García (3)
Affiliations:
1. Department of Botany, Faculty of Science, Charles University, Prague, Czech Republic
2. Institute of Botany, Czech Academy of Sciences, Průhonice, Czech Republic
3. Estación Biológica de Doñana (EBD-CSIC), Sevilla, Spain
Abstract:
Pollinators move pollen between flowers, but how much of it reaches conspecific stigmas remains poorly quantified. We followed individual visits and counted grains deposited after single visits. Seed set increased by 35% (p < 0.01) when flowers received supplemental pollen; costs were ~$2 per plot.

In a second experiment, we contact @EcoFlor and show that _Bombus terrestris_ dominated visits.
